meta.name: opportunity-solution-tree
meta.description: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree from outcomes to opportunities, solutions, and tests. Use when a stakeholder request needs problem framing before you decide what to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将利益相关者请求转化为可验证的解决方案树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在决定构建什么之前先对需求进行问题框架分析
copy.tagline_en: Transform stakeholder requests into a verifiable solution tree
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to frame problems before deciding what to build

howto.what: 引导你从利益相关者的需求出发，先明确业务目标，再找出客户问题（机会），然后构思解决方案，最后选出最值得先做的概念验证方案。
howto.when: 当收到一个模糊的产品需求或功能请求，需要先理清问题再决定做什么时触发。

say.text: 销售说我们需要一个移动应用，因为竞争对手有。帮我做个机会解决方案树。
say.note: 技能会提取目标结果，生成机会和方案。

say.text: 我们想提高试用转付费率，从15%提升到25%。
say.note: 技能会围绕这个目标生成机会和方案。

howto.what_en: Guides you from a stakeholder request to a structured Opportunity Solution Tree: extract a measurable outcome, identify customer problems (opportunities), map solutions, and select the best proof-of-concept to test first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a vague product request or feature idea and need to frame the problem before deciding what to build.

say_en.text: Sales says we need a mobile app because competitors have one. Build an OST from this request.
say_en.note: Skill extracts outcome, generates opportunities and solutions.

say_en.text: We want to increase trial-to-paid conversion from 15% to 25%.
say_en.note: Skill generates opportunities and solutions for that outcome.
